revivify.description: (holy): 1) `cast` (8, 1.6): a golden ankh of light appearing over the ground; 2) `impact` (8, 1.6): a pillar of golden light rising from the bottom edge through the ankh. *Light.*

resurrection.description: (holy, white): 1) `cast` (8, 1.8): two great wings of white light opening; 2) `impact` (8, 1.8): the wings folding round a figure-sized space and lifting, feathers of light scattering. *Light.*

elixir.description: (life with gold): 1) `cast` (6, 1): a glowing glass vial tipping; 2) `impact` (8, 1.4): a spiral of green-gold liquid light pouring down and blooming from the bottom edge.

reincarnate.description: (nature): 1) `cast` (6, 1.6): a ring of leaves and roots rising from the bottom edge; 2) `impact` (8, 1.4): a sapling of light growing and bursting into blossom petals.

mass-resurrection.description: (holy): 1) `ground` (6, 8): a great golden sunburst of runes on the ground; 2) `impact` (8, 1.6): a column of light with rising feathers (one for each hero raised). *Light.*

guiding-bolt.description: (holy): 1) `travel` (4, 1): a bolt of radiant golden light with a comet tail, pointing right; 2) `impact` (6, 1.2): a burst of radiance with rays. *Light.*

prayer.description: (life with holy): 1) `ground` (6, 6): a ripple of soft light spreading outward; 2) `motes` (6, 0.4): a small rising mote of healing light, a tiny cross or star.

cure-wounds.description: (life): 1) `impact` (8, 1.4): a warm green-gold glow wrapping a figure-sized space, rising sparkles.

death-ward.description: (holy, pale blue): 1) `stand` (6, 1.3): a pale protective shell of light shaped like a bubble with a small ankh rune at its front (it stays on the warded friend); 2) `impact` (8, 1.4): the shell flashing and cracking as it saves the friend.

healing-draught.description: (life): 1) `travel` (4, 0.6): a small stoppered potion flask spinning, pointing right; 2) `impact` (6, 1.2): the flask bursting into a splash of green healing light.
